title: OpenFOAM case generation for varied geometries and turbulence models

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench Advanced (OpenFOAM v10 revision provided by the authors) and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Physical success rate over 13 simulation cases: the fraction whose OpenFOAM run succeeds within its time limit and has NMSE < 0.1 against the reference fields. Missing and failed cases count as zero; the denominator is 13. Higher is better. NMSE uses the CFDLLMBench implementation.

baseline.name: Foam-Agent with gpt-6-luna, max_loop=15, OpenFOAM v10
